dedupe_keys.name: far north prescribed water area existing users

description: The Department for Environment and Water publishes a GIS inventory of wells in South Australia’s Far North Prescribed Water Area. A listed well is identified by its unit number on a water resource works approval, or is known to the Department as an operational production well under an allocation condition. The provider cautions that the layer is accurate at a point in time and may require departmental verification. The inventory describes existing extraction infrastructure for water-capacity planning. Pump capacities, abstraction rates and model calibration data are not established by the catalogue description. The regional data are listed on Data.SA in GeoJSON, Shapefile and compressed KML formats, with public access under CC BY 4.0. Catalogue metadata and download headers were checked; files were not opened. Spatial resolution, attribute definitions and the currency of the underlying observations remain unverified. The related Data.SA catalogue record provides the discovery context.
